test_faiss_index_with_torch_tensors: test adding and searching vectors in a Faiss IndexFlatL2 using PyTorch tensors on CPU
test_ivfflat_train_and_add_with_ids: test training an IndexIVFFlat and adding vectors with explicit IDs using PyTorch tensors
test_reconstruct_and_reconstruct_n: test reconstructing single and batch vectors from a Faiss index using PyTorch or NumPy outputs
test_python_kmeans_clustering: test the pure Python kmeans implementation from faiss.contrib.torch.clustering with a DatasetAssign wrapper
test_python_product_quantization: test the pure PyTorch ProductQuantizer from faiss.contrib.torch.quantization for encoding and decoding vectors
